description.value: Krave Kulture is a craft yogurt shop in Edgemont Village that bills itself as Vancouver's first, founded during the pandemic by Kamran and Moji and now expanded to a second location at Lonsdale Quay. The shop makes fresh yogurt in-house daily from organic Canadian milk, serving froyo bowls, smoothies, and probiotic-rich kefir. It has grown into a community hub and offers school and corporate programs alongside its walk-up retail trade.
